dialogue.content: こんにちはよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: 少し早いですが、始めてもよろしいですか勿論時間どうりでも、よろしいです
dialogue.English: It’s a little early, but may we begin? Of course, we can also start at the scheduled time if you prefer.

dialogue.content: 初めても大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.English: It's fine to start now.

dialogue.content: こんにちは相談員です本日はありがとうございますよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, I’m the counselor. Thank you for coming today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそどうぞよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. I'm looking forward to our session.

dialogue.content: 今日は、どのようなご相談ですか
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: はい、、父親の酒癖の悪さに困っています…
dialogue.English: Yes... I'm having a problem with my father's bad drinking habits.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・お困りですよね
dialogue.English: I see... That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい、どうしてそうなるのかといつもとても嫌な気持ちになります
dialogue.English: Yes, I always wonder why it has to be this way, and it makes me feel awful.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・いつものことになると、嫌になりますよね
dialogue.English: I understand... When it becomes a regular occurrence, it's natural to feel fed up.

dialogue.content: いつ頃からですか
dialogue.English: How long has this been going on?

dialogue.content: 私が小3の時からです。今は私は22さいです。
dialogue.English: Since I was in third grade. I’m 22 now.

dialogue.content: それは、ずいぶん前からになりますよね
dialogue.English: That's been going on for quite a long time, hasn't it?

dialogue.content: ご家族は、何人ですか
dialogue.English: How many people are in your family?

dialogue.content: 両親と姉妹とで5人家族です。
dialogue.English: It's a family of five: my parents, my sisters, and me.

dialogue.content: 一緒にお住まいなのですね
dialogue.English: You all live together, right?

dialogue.content: はい。姉は結婚して出ていきました。あ、なので妹と両親で4人でした。
dialogue.English: Yes. My older sister got married and moved out. Oh, so it’s actually four of us now—my younger sister, my parents, and me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、はいありがとうございます
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for telling me.

dialogue.content: お父さんは、今お仕事は、されていますか
dialogue.English: Is your father currently working?

dialogue.content: 仕事はちゃんとしてくれて給料も入れてくれています。飲まない時は、真面目で優しい良い父親ですが。
dialogue.English: He does his job properly and contributes his salary. When he's not drinking, he's a serious, kind, and good father.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・お父さん、とても良い方なのですね
dialogue.English: I see... It sounds like he can be a very good person.

dialogue.content: 普段はそうですが、飲むと人が変わります
dialogue.English: Usually, yes, but when he drinks, he becomes a different person.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・それは、困ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I understand... That must be very troubling.

dialogue.content: お酒が入ると、どんなことを、言われるのですか
dialogue.English: When he’s been drinking, what kinds of things does he say?

dialogue.content: 夜中に帰宅して、母親に暴言をはいたり、物を壊したり、、
dialogue.English: He comes home late at night, verbally abuses my mother, and breaks things...

dialogue.content: 酔ってるので声も大きく、叫んだりして近所にも迷惑かけています
dialogue.English: Because he's drunk, he's also very loud, shouting and disturbing the neighbors.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・それは、お困りですね
dialogue.English: I see... That must be very distressing.

dialogue.content: 近所でも噂されてると思うと、肩身が狭しい、母が可哀想です
dialogue.English: Thinking that the neighbors might be gossiping about us makes me feel ashamed, and I feel sorry for my mother.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・・近所の目を考えてしまいますし、お母さんのことも、心配になりますよね
dialogue.English: That makes sense... It’s natural to worry about what the neighbors think, and also to be concerned for your mother.

dialogue.content: お母さんは、何か、おっしゃっていますか
dialogue.English: Has your mother said anything about it?

dialogue.content: 私たちが小さい時はよく泣いていました。私が成人してからはどうしたら良いか話し合ったりはしています
dialogue.English: When we were little, she used to cry a lot. Since I've become an adult, we've been discussing what to do.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・おかあさん、昔から、辛い思いをされてきたのですね
dialogue.English: I see... So your mother has been going through a hard time for a long time.

dialogue.content: どんな話し合いをされていらっしゃるのですか
dialogue.English: What kind of discussions have you been having?

dialogue.content: 離婚も何度も突きつけたのですが、、『離婚はしたくない、これからきをつける』と土下座して謝るのです。
dialogue.English: She has brought up divorce many times, but he gets on his knees and apologizes, saying, 'I don't want a divorce, I'll be careful from now on.'

dialogue.content: 飲んでいない時に話すとちゃんと反省はしてるようなのですが、しばらくするとまた飲み過ぎて問題を起こします
dialogue.English: When we talk to him when he's sober, he seems to genuinely regret it, but after a while, he starts drinking too much and causing trouble again.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・繰り返してしまわれるのですね
dialogue.English: I see... It keeps repeating, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、とにかく、飲み過ぎます。飲み出したら止まらないようで
dialogue.English: Yes, he just drinks too much. Once he starts, he can’t seem to stop.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・お酒が大好きなんですね、
dialogue.English: I see... He must really love to drink, doesn't he?

dialogue.content: お酒の依存は、大丈夫でしょうか心配ですね
dialogue.English: I'm concerned. Could it be alcohol dependency?

dialogue.content: 依存だと思います
dialogue.English: I think it's a dependency.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・それは、お困りですよね
dialogue.English: I see... That must be very difficult.

dialogue.content: 家族がどれだけお願いしても、本人もなおすとは言ってくれますが、直りません
dialogue.English: No matter how much the family begs him, and even though he says he'll change, he doesn't.

dialogue.content: そのようなことを心配されて、ご相談にいらしたのですね一緒に考えていきましょう
dialogue.English: You came to consult with me because you’re worried about these things. Let’s think it through together.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'd appreciate that.

dialogue.content: ところで、お名前をなんとお呼びしたら、よろしいですか
dialogue.English: By the way, what would you like me to call you?

dialogue.content: ミキといいます
dialogue.English: My name is Miki.

dialogue.content: ミキさんですねありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Miki, got it. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 妹さんは、お父さんのことを、どのように思っていますか
dialogue.English: How does your younger sister feel about your father?

dialogue.content: 私と同じです。家族みな、これだけお願いしても父がお酒をやめないのが嫌でたまりません。
dialogue.English: She feels the same as I do. All of us in the family are fed up that he won’t stop drinking no matter how much we beg him.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 本当に家族を想っているなら、泣いてお願いされたらお酒を飲むのやめてほしいです。
dialogue.English: If he really cared about his family, I wish he'd stop drinking when we beg him through tears.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's understandable.

dialogue.content: 依存って自分ではやめられないって事なのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Does dependency mean you can't stop on your own?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: In many cases, yes.

dialogue.content: おとうさんは、自分で、分かっているのに、お酒の力に支配されています
dialogue.English: Your father knows it himself, but he's being controlled by the power of alcohol.

dialogue.content: そうだと思います
dialogue.English: I think so too.

dialogue.content: 支配するお酒が、とても憎いですね
dialogue.English: It’s understandable to feel a lot of resentment toward the alcohol that is controlling him.

dialogue.content: 本当に、、芸能人のニュースでもお酒トラブル見聞きします
dialogue.English: It really is... I hear about alcohol-related troubles in the news about celebrities, too.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's true.

dialogue.content: お酒は、楽しみで、飲むものですが、飲みすぎると、大変なことになってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: Alcohol is something to be enjoyed, but if you drink too much, it can lead to serious problems.

dialogue.content: 自分でコントロールして欲しいです
dialogue.English: I want him to control himself.

dialogue.content: そうですねお酒が入っていないときは、お父さんと、お母さんは、仲がよろしいのですか
dialogue.English: I agree. When he isn't drinking, do your father and mother get along well?

dialogue.content: お酒飲んでなくても、母は、不満が溜まってるのでギクシャクしています。家の中が暗いです。
dialogue.English: Even when he’s not drinking, my mother has so much pent-up frustration that things are awkward. The atmosphere at home is gloomy.

dialogue.content: いつも喧嘩が絶えないです。
dialogue.English: They're always fighting.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・戸惑いますし、寂しいですよね喧嘩は、みていて、嫌ですね、はらはらしますよね
dialogue.English: I see... That must be confusing and lonely for you. It's unpleasant to watch them fight; it must make you anxious.

dialogue.content: 私自身も、両親とは何かとあわないです。
dialogue.English: I also don’t get along with my parents in many ways.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね両親のことを、どのように感じられていますか
dialogue.English: I understand. How do you feel about your parents?

dialogue.content: お酒ばかり飲んでダメな父親、母親も私とはぶつかってばかりなので家にも居たくないです。
dialogue.English: A father who just drinks and is no good, and a mother who keeps clashing with me—I don’t even want to be at home.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: お母さんとは、どんなことで、ぶつかってしまいますか
dialogue.English: What kinds of things do you and your mother clash over?

dialogue.content: 私の行動が気に入らないので文句を言われます。帰宅時間遅いとか、服装が派手とか
dialogue.English: She complains because she doesn’t like my behavior—like coming home late or dressing flashily.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・もう、22歳なので、好きにしたい、ほっておいてほしい、ですよね
dialogue.English: I see... You're 22 now, so you want to do things your way and be left alone, right?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: でも、お父さんのことも、心配なんですよね
dialogue.English: But you're also worried about your father, aren't you?

dialogue.content: 心配もありますが、家族に迷惑かけてほしくないです。なおしてほしいです
dialogue.English: I am worried, but I don't want him to cause trouble for the family. I want him to get better.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・・もどかしさと、いらだちも、ありますよね
dialogue.English: I understand... You must feel a sense of frustration and irritation.

dialogue.content: 家には、お酒が常にある状態ですか
dialogue.English: Is there always alcohol in the house?

dialogue.content: あまり置かないようにしていますが、父が自分で買って来ますし、外でも飲みます
dialogue.English: We try not to keep much around, but my father buys it himself, and he also drinks out.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・困りますよね
dialogue.English: I see... That's troubling, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 飲むだけなら良いのですが、騒いだり、物を壊す、さらには、警察に連れて行かれた事もあるので、そんなのが困ります
dialogue.English: If it were just the drinking, that would be one thing, but he makes a scene, breaks things, and has even been taken in by the police. That’s what's so difficult.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・困りますね、びっくりしてしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I see... That is difficult. It must be shocking when that happens.

dialogue.content: あと、財布を落とす、川に落ちて溺れる、スーツを破って帰ってくる、など、数えきれません。
dialogue.English: Also, he's lost his wallet, fallen in a river and almost drowned, come home with his suit torn... there are too many incidents to count.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・それは、やるせないですね実は、お酒の依存は、とても怖いもので、個人家族では解決できないこともあります、
dialogue.English: I see... That's heartbreaking. The truth is, alcohol dependency is a very serious thing, and sometimes it can't be resolved by the individual or family alone.

dialogue.content: だと思います。もう何年も話し合いしてもダメなのでどうすればいいのか、、
dialogue.English: I think so. We've been talking about it for years and it hasn't worked, so I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: ↑ことが、アルコール依存は、ほとんどです
dialogue.English: That is the case with most alcohol dependencies.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: まずは、一度、病院にいって、みるのは、いかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: First, how about going to a hospital to get him checked out?

dialogue.content: どのように思われますか
dialogue.English: How does that sound to you?

dialogue.content: どんな病院に行ってみるといいのですか？
dialogue.English: What kind of hospital would be good to go to?

dialogue.content: 病院で先生に診断されると少しは違うかもしれないです
dialogue.English: If he gets a diagnosis from a doctor at a hospital, maybe things will change a little.

dialogue.content: お酒の依存症なので、出来れば、総合病院の精神科が、お薦めですが、どのように、思われますか
dialogue.English: Since it's alcohol dependency, the psychiatric department of a general hospital would be my recommendation. What are your thoughts?

dialogue.content: 精神科で、嫌悪療法がされています
dialogue.English: They offer aversion therapy in psychiatric departments.

dialogue.content: あ、精神科、ですね。やはり、自力では難しいので医者に診てもらうべきですよね。
dialogue.English: Oh, psychiatry. I see. Since it’s hard for him to do it on his own, he should see a doctor, right?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, I think so.

dialogue.content: そういう、療法がちゃんとあるんですね
dialogue.English: So there are actual therapies for this.

dialogue.content: 今まで、家族の恥なので誰にも相談できなかったんです。
dialogue.English: Until now, I couldn't talk to anyone about it because I thought it was a family shame.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そう思ってしまっていたのですね
dialogue.English: So that's how you've been feeling.

dialogue.content: 酒癖が悪い父親とか、みっともなくて、、
dialogue.English: A father with bad drinking habits... it's just so embarrassing...

dialogue.content: 子供の頃から人に知られたくなかったので。
dialogue.English: Ever since I was a child, I didn’t want people to know.

dialogue.content: わかりました。でも、病気なら、病院にまず行ってみるべきですね
dialogue.English: I understand. But if it's an illness, then we should go to the hospital first.

dialogue.content: そう思われるのは、もっともなことだと思わtrます一度行ってみては、いかがですか
dialogue.English: It's completely understandable that you feel that way. How about giving it a try?

dialogue.content: はい、母に相談して行ってみます。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll discuss it with my mother and we'll try to go.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。まだ治ったわけではないですが、一歩、前に進めました。
dialogue.English: Thank you. It isn’t solved yet, but I feel like I’ve taken a step forward.

dialogue.content: そうですねおとうさんが、少しでも良い方向にむかわれますように、応援しています
dialogue.English: Yes. I hope your father moves in a better direction, even just a little. I’m rooting for you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。やってみます
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. We’ll give it a try.

dialogue.content: それは、良かったです
dialogue.English: I’m glad to hear that.

dialogue.content: それからまた考えます
dialogue.English: After that, we’ll think about it again.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、ありがとうございますそれから、また、考えてみてください
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. After that, please take some time to think it over.

dialogue.content: 何かありましたら、また、いらしてください
dialogue.English: If anything comes up, please feel free to come back.

dialogue.content: はい、相談にのっていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you for listening to me.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: これで、相談を終了させていただきますありがとうございます
dialogue.English: This concludes our session. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ロールプレイ、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for the role-play.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: それでは、ボタン押します
dialogue.English: Okay, I'll press the button now.

dialogue.content: はい、終了でお願いいたします。お疲れ様でした！
dialogue.English: Yes, please end the session. Thank you for your time!

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でした
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time.
